skill.name: policy-opa
skill.description: Build, test, and integrate Open Policy Agent policies for Kubernetes, Terraform, and compliance workflows.
skill.summary: Create and validate OPA Rego policies for infrastructure security and compliance checks.
skill.author: AgentSecOps

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are benign documentation examples, Rego imports, or policy checks for unsafe infrastructure patterns. I confirmed three supply-chain risks where examples download or apply mutable remote resources without pinning or verification. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious command execution intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Pin an OPA release version and verify checksums in SKILL.md and CI examples before installation.

remediation.issue: Remote Gatekeeper manifest applied from master
remediation.suggestion: Use a pinned Gatekeeper release URL or vendored manifest, then review it before kubectl apply.

remediation.issue: Terraform plan sensitivity is not documented clearly
remediation.suggestion: Warn users that tfplan.json can contain sensitive values and should not be stored in public logs or artifacts.

content.value_statement: Security teams need repeatable checks for infrastructure and compliance drift. This skill guides OPA Rego policy creation, testing, and CI/CD integration.
actual_capabilities: Drafts Rego policies for Kubernetes admission control and pod security.
Provides OPA evaluation and test commands for local and CI use.
Maps example controls to SOC2, PCI-DSS, GDPR, and HIPAA themes.
Includes Terraform and cloud infrastructure policy examples.
Shows GitHub Actions and GitLab CI patterns for policy validation.
limitations: Does not include executable helper scripts referenced in the documentation.
Does not verify live cluster or cloud account settings by itself.
Requires users to install OPA, kubectl, Terraform, jq, or CI tooling separately.
Compliance mappings are examples and do not replace legal or audit review.

use_cases.title: Validate Kubernetes Deployments
use_cases.description: Create Gatekeeper and Rego checks that block privileged pods, host namespaces, and unsafe volume settings.

use_cases.title: Review Terraform Plans
use_cases.description: Evaluate Terraform plan output for public databases, broad IAM permissions, and open management ports.

use_cases.title: Prepare Compliance Evidence
use_cases.description: Map policy checks to SOC2, PCI-DSS, GDPR, and HIPAA control examples for audit discussions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Policy
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an OPA Rego policy that denies Kubernetes pods using privileged containers. Explain the expected input fields.

prompt_templates.title: Add Policy Tests
prompt_templates.prompt: Write unit test scenarios for this Rego policy. Include allowed and denied Kubernetes pod cases.

prompt_templates.title: Integrate with CI
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a CI policy validation step for Terraform plan output. Include failure behavior and secret-handling precautions.

prompt_templates.title: Map Controls to Compliance
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these OPA policies against SOC2 and PCI-DSS goals. Identify gaps, overlapping checks, and evidence outputs.

output_examples.input: A Kubernetes deployment allows privileged containers and lacks a seccomp profile.
output_examples.output: The response identifies both violations, explains the affected fields, and suggests safer pod security settings.

output_examples.input: A Terraform plan contains a public RDS instance and SSH open to the internet.
output_examples.output: The response lists the policy failures, ranks their severity, and recommends private networking changes.

output_examples.input: A team needs PCI-DSS evidence for container and network controls.
output_examples.output: The response maps policy checks to relevant control themes and notes evidence that auditors may request.

best_practices: Pin OPA, Gatekeeper, and CI action versions before production use.
Keep Terraform plans and policy outputs out of public logs and artifacts.
Pair each policy with unit tests and documented control ownership.
anti_patterns: Do not copy remote installation commands without checksum or release verification.
Do not treat example compliance mappings as complete audit evidence.
Do not evaluate sensitive plans in shared runners without retention controls.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build OPA Rego policies for Kubernetes, Terraform, and compliance-oriented configuration checks.

faq.question: Does it run OPA automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides commands and examples that users run in their own environment.

faq.question: Can it replace a compliance audit?
faq.answer: No. It supports control validation, but auditors and legal reviewers decide compliance scope.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include ready-made scripts?
faq.answer: The documentation references helper scripts, but this package does not include a scripts directory.

faq.question: What should users verify before production use?
faq.answer: Users should pin external downloads, test policies, and protect Terraform plan files from log exposure.
